about_the_game:
"ARCH WIZARD Demo" is a Post-Power-Fantasy fast paced First-Person-Shooter:

  • 1 hp and no upgrade system

  • 30 memorized spells + combos

  • Very distinct enemies

  • 10 min. tight arenas

  • Your progression is your knowledge (mainly) and your skills

Blend all your moves, skills and abilities into one personalized flow of magic rage. A calculated ever adapting dance between enemies. Using their attacks and even detached body parts to dig into the depths of combat spell craft.

You are a powerful mage. Lost in the ruins of warp portal network, once connecting the outskirts of the multiverse.
You must fight your way through cosmoses. Challenge the most powerful entities. Rescue, steal or destroy the pillars of Reality itself.
To become the eternal ARCH WIZARD.

The demo version is limited to one game biome in four that will be available in the full game. It will also include additional 30 spells and some amount of spell combinations.

Trailer music contains tracks: Shadows And Dust by Scott Buckley and Creepy Dark Atmosphere by Universfield

short_description: Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World. Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.
